blurb.zh: 看全局、拍板、找钱，杂事交给 Bot。
blurb.en: See the whole picture and make the calls; hand the busywork to Bots.

blurb.zh: 店铺、社群和活动，每天的数和每周的复盘。
blurb.en: Stores, communities and campaigns, the daily numbers and the weekly review.

blurb.zh: 活动方案、搜索内容和竞品动向。
blurb.en: Campaign plans, search content and competitor moves.

blurb.zh: 找线索、跟客户、报价和复盘。
blurb.en: Find leads, follow up, quote and review.

blurb.zh: 工单、话术和评价回复，口径统一。
blurb.en: Tickets, scripts and review replies, all saying the same thing.
Requirements, PRDs, competitors and user feedback.

blurb.zh: 代码审查、排查故障、写文档和 SQL。
blurb.en: Code review, incidents, docs and SQL.

blurb.zh: 把需求问清楚，文案和版式先过一遍。
blurb.en: Pin down the brief and check the copy and layout first.

blurb.zh: 看板、问卷和报表，讲清楚变了什么。
blurb.en: Dashboards, surveys and reports, explaining what changed.

blurb.zh: 排期、周报、风险和会议待办。
blurb.en: Schedules, status reports, risks and meeting actions.

blurb.zh: 票据、现金流、报价和回款。
blurb.en: Receipts, cash flow, quotes and collections.

blurb.zh: 合同、合规和用工的第一道把关。
blurb.en: A first pass on contracts, compliance and employment.

blurb.zh: 差旅、通知、会议和办公杂事。
blurb.en: Travel, notices, meetings and office errands.
Compare suppliers, chase orders and restock.

blurb.zh: 公众号、短视频、小红书和直播。
blurb.en: Articles, short video, social posts and live streams.

blurb.zh: 接单、报价、作品集，也照顾好自己的日子。
blurb.en: Gigs, quotes and portfolios, and everyday life too.
